text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. we need firm owners and gating checks for three items: adaptive batching (API), per-route cost view (Console), and Optimize suggestions UI. trying to lock dates for comms.
Ana: owners recap: Jamal -> adaptive batching, Lin+billing -> per-route cost, Priya -> Optimize UI.
Jamal: adaptive batching canary target 2024-07-01 on a small fleet. open beta ~4 weeks after. will provide sample route + node script.
Trevor: infra note: we'll run load tests 2024-06-27 and add a migration toggle for Dedicated pinned models. need eng-sre to monitor p95 and KV eviction.
Ella: DevEx will draft SDK snippet and "what changed" blurb. Jamal, please confirm flag name.
Jamal: use `enable_adaptive_batching` in SDK. example: `client.updateConfig({enable_adaptive_batching:true,batching:{max_latency_ms:20}})`. we'll include ordering caveat.
Kevin: marketing needs screenshots for console cost view. who owns mock data?
Priya: Optimize canary needs extended eval retention (opt-in) ~30 days. Ops ok if orgs opt-in. Trevor to open JIRA for retention opt-in.
docs-bot: docs ask: attach a token-profile.csv and route sample to the ticket for reproducible screenshots.
Mira: action items: (1) Jamal publish sample route + script by 2024-06-20, (2) Kevin/Ella screenshots by 2024-06-26, (3) Trevor open retention JIRA by 2024-06-19, (4) Lin prepare tooltip copy for "estimate" by 2024-07-10.
Ana: gating checks: no p95 regression >10%, cache-hit impact <2%, feature-flagged rollout, docs + SDK sample published.
Mira: thanks all. I'll collate and send to marketing/docs. will ping owners next Monday for readiness.
